Container.Name: Stoat-Chat
Container.Overview:
Stoat is a self-hosted chat platform - an open source alternative to Discord.
IMPORTANT: This is a multi-container application. Use the docker-compose setup in the unraid folder.
Features: - Real-time messaging with WebSocket support - File uploads and attachments - Image/link previews - GIF search via Tenor - Push notifications - Full API access
Requirements: - Domain name with DNS pointing to your server - Ports 80 and 443 available (or use behind reverse proxy) - At least 2GB RAM recommended
Setup Instructions: 1. SSH into your Unraid server 2. Navigate to: /mnt/user/appdata/stoat 3. Clone the repo or copy the unraid folder contents 4. Run: ./setup-unraid.sh your.domain.com 5. Run: docker compose up -d
Container.Requires:
This is a docker-compose based application. Please use the setup script and docker-compose instead of this template directly.
See: https://github.com/revoltchat/self-hosted/tree/master/unraid
